title: Resin Dice
body:
**The direct download doesn't download the resource pack for whatever reason. Go to [here](https://modrinth.com/datapack/resin-dice/version/v2.0.0) to download the resource pack.**

Adds dice that can be made out of resin. There's 7 dice: the coin, d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, and d20.

![the seven new items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee5be00b970e1e734f7665b5548d6a66fa7927dc.png)

You can also change what matterial they're made of using the Smithing Table:
- Bone
- Iron Ingot
- Clay Ball
- Gunpowder
- Flint
- Coal / Charcoal
- Netherite Scrap
- Brick
- Redstone Dust
- Nautilus Shell
- Resin Clump (if you wanted to return it to resin)
- Copper Ingot
- Gold Ingot
- Bamboo
- Emerald
- Heart of the Sea
- Diamond
- Prismarine Shard / Prismarine Crystals
- Lapis Lazuli
- Echo Shard
- Amethyst Shard
- Eye of Ender
- Popper Chorus Fruit
- Nether Star
